s: Dine betziat happat, ubo seip echad: lo ameru "tekep lintilat yadayim seuda", ella shello yitasseq benetayim beezeh eseq ad sheyyassiach dato mehasseuda. Vaapillu limzog kos leqiddush hayyom, im mozego bechammin, shetztzarik ledaqdeq harbeh shello yechasser o yeyatter — hare zeh hessach haddaat mehasseuda, veasur laasoto ben netilat yadayim lasseuda. Vehu haddin lekol kayyotze bazeh. Abal im yosheb batel veeno oseh benetayim shum maaseh sheyyesh bo hessach haddaat, ap al pi sheshshoheh harbeh, vaapillu mesiach meat — en lachosh, kevan shehashshulchan lepanayv vedato leekol. Ubilbad shello yaplig bidbarim, shello yabo lide hessach haddaat. Velaken muttar lomar qiddush vehabdala ben netilat yadayim le"hammotzi". Velo ameru "tekep lintilat yadayim beraka", ella bemayim acharonim bilbad. Veyesh omerim sheggam bemayim rishonim tzarik lizzaher kemo bemayim acharonim, shehare ameru: "hattokep lintilat yadayim beraka — eno nizzoq bekol otah seuda", vezehu bemayim rishonim, shebbemayim acharonim mah shehaya kebar haya. Lepikak, tzarik lizzaher shello lehapsiq apillu bishhiyya kede hilluk k"b amma, shebbeshiur zeh niqra hepseq apillu yosheb bimqomo (veim halak mibbeto lebayit acher — niqra hepseq apillu holek meat). Veshello letzorek en lehapsiq apillu bishhiyya muetet. Uledabber asur apillu bedibre tora (o ezeh beraka merubba shello meinyan hasseuda, kegon lehabdil al hakkos). Veen tzarik lomar bidbar chol. Vetob lachosh ledibrehem. Umikkol maqom, en tzarik lizzaher ella milledabber beezeh eseq veinyan acher, abal sicha beolma b' o g' tebot — enan chashubin hepseq ledibre hakkol, apillu bemayim acharonim (kevan sheen bahem inyan shalem). Vekol shekken shemmuttar lehashib hen o lav kesheshshoalin oto dabar. Umeinyan hasseuda utzerakeha eno chashub hepseq apillu ben "hammotzi" laakila, kol shekken ben netila le"hammotzi". Vekol shekken shehashshehiyya beniggub vehilluk mimmaqom shennatal yadayv limqom hasseuda enan chashubin hepseq, kevan shehu tzorek hasseuda. Ella shellekattechilla tzarik littol yadayv samuk limqom hasseuda im epshar, (sh)kemo shetztzarik limzog hakkos shel qiddush bechammin qodem hannetila ledibre hakkol, ap al pi shehaqqiddush hu tzorek hasseuda, kevan sheepshar limzog qodem hannetila. (Vaapillu lekattechilla muttar lehapsiq betzorke seuda ben netila le"hammotzi" im shakach alehem qodem hannetila, ap al pi sheaseru ben "hammotzi" laakila). Laken mi shennoheg lehitpallel bekol yom al mezono qodem hasseuda kemo shekkatub bazzohar haqqadosh, veshakach lehitpallel qodem hannetila — muttar lo lehapsiq bekak ben netila le"hammotzi". Vehaolam nahagu lomar mizmor "Hashem roi" ben netila le"hammotzi" (veyesh lelammed alehem zekut, lepi shellipamim sheen hayyadayim neqiyyot qodem hannetila, vekevan shezzehu meinyan seuda veeno chashub hepseq ledibre hakkol — heqellu bo shello litroach lehizzaher leomro qodem hannetila beniqyon kappayim):
